description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 
 Description
 We are seeking a motivated engineer to join the development team for the industry-leading Adams MultiBody Dynamics application.   Cadence is looking for additional software developers to implement multi-body dynamics business logic and improved modeling methodologies as a part of systems modeling architectural modernization and transformation initiative.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Implement Adams Application back-end business logic and persistence
 Implement Adams UI extensions
 Implement new modeling objects and templates for Adams
 Modernize the Adams application back-end to take advantage of modern hardware
 Improve software quality through ever-expanding coverage of functionality within automated test suites
 Implement build and test pipeline logic
 Collaborate with rest of Adams product development teams in an Agile Development process.
 Collaborate with other groups within Cadence for cross-product synergies and common technology
 Contribute to debugging, usability improvements, and technical documentation for delivered features.
 Required Skills / Experience
 Python Scripting
 Multi-layered software architecture with framework, plug-ins, and public API
 VSCode + CoPilot
 Strong familiarity with Agentic AI, leveraging AI for productivity gains
 Strong written and verbal communication skills
 Preferred Qualifications
 C++ Coding Experience
 QT Coding experience
 Familiarity with MVVM , MVC coding patterns
 Vtune software
 JIRA
 CAD/CAE familiarity
 Coding for GPU
 Education and Experience
 Recent 2026 grad with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
 0-2  Years Experience
 We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.
